activity.notes: Later Korean historical tradition identifies Jumong with Dongmyeongseong, the founding king of Goguryeo, and assigns a reign of 37–19 BCE. The same tradition contains mythic narrative elements and scholarship distinguishes the broader Dongmyeong myth from the historical founder tradition. ATLAS therefore preserves the conventional reign interval but marks both boundaries approximate and the Activity confidence likely rather than fully certain.

sources.title: 동명성왕
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture presents Dongmyeongseong/Jumong as Goguryeo's first king with the traditional reign 37–19 BCE while discussing the mythic and historiographical complexity of the tradition.
